stories.headline: CUSTODIAN closeout watch: dual-disposition recovery remains next
stories.summary: Baseline from the October 30 evening watch: no new main commit identified. Dual-disposition recovery implementation and review packets remain ready; acceptance and host teardown remain unverified.
stories.body: The latest completed CUSTODIAN Project Watch reported main at 0da34470d1 with no newly identified landing or PR milestone. The earlier redacted-final-outcome recovery implementation was reported landed/archived; its independent acceptance remains unverified. The next documented dependency is implementing and independently reviewing dual-disposition recovery. Any exact-run recovery requires separate explicit authorization afterward. GitHub cannot establish live local Codex execution, worktree retirement, locks or disk recovery.
